Name: Better Married Shane Updated for 1.6
Author: Jamcan02
Description:
This mod was originally made by Auronlova. The original mod can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1167]here[/url]. I simply converted the dialogues they wrote to work under Content Patcher so that the mod works with the game's 1.6 update!

[u]About:[/u]
This mod aims to make Shane's marriage less cold and more enjoyable. There's also several dialogues from other NPCs talking about your marriage.
[u]WARNING!!![/u] This mode includes subtle innuendos. [size=1]*wink wink*[/size]

[u]Installation:[/u]
Make sure you have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed.
Copy and Paste/Move the folder [font=Courier New][CP] Better Married Shane updated for 1.6[/font] into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

This is my first ever mod! Feel free to let me know if there are any bugs. I don't guarantee compatibility with other mods.

The portait mod I used can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21039]here[/url]. The character sprite mod I used can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1437]here[/url]. They're my personal favorites!

Have fun!
